claims.text: Adding 10–15 wt% MoS2 to CoCrFeNi will lower both friction and wear from room temperature through 800 °C.
Monolithic CoCrFeNi has higher friction and wear, especially at elevated temperatures.
MoS2-containing HEA composites with up to 15 wt% MoS2 can be produced using powder processing associated with spark plasma sintering.
Spark plasma sintering 10–15 wt% MoS2 with CoCrFeNi will produce uniformly dispersed MoS2 particles.
Sliding will cause the dispersed MoS2 particles to generate a continuous, adherent tribofilm.
MoS2 particles provide low-shear-strength interfaces that reduce tangential sliding forces.
MoS2 or its decomposed lubricious phases will form a protective film at both low and high temperatures.
The protective film will minimize direct metal-to-metal contact and thereby reduce friction and abrasive wear.
The MoS2-derived film will accommodate elastic–plastic deformation of the CoCrFeNi matrix.
The intervention is expected to remain effective during sliding in oxidizing air from room temperature to 800 °C under typical tribological-test loads.
Loads substantially above those tested or non-oxidizing environments may alter the intervention's performance.
The long-term thermal stability of MoS2 in CoCrFeNi at 800 °C is unresolved.
MoS2 has shown beneficial tribological behavior in a related AlCoCrFeNiTi high-entropy-alloy system.
In the cited AlCoCrFeNiTi system, at least 10 wt% MoS2 was required to improve wear behavior at room and elevated temperatures.
The optimal MoS2 concentration for a CoCrFeNi matrix is not established.
Oxidation or decomposition of MoS2 near 800 °C may impair tribofilm formation.
Pure CoCrFeNi and SPS-processed CoCrFeNi containing 10–15 wt% MoS2 will be compared by identical ball-on-disk tests at room temperature, 400 °C, 600 °C, and 800 °C in ambient air.

The hypothesis is falsified if the modified samples fail to show statistically significant reductions in both coefficient of friction and wear rate at every tested temperature, or if no continuous or effective lubricating film is detected.
